title: Makerfabs Nomad Terminal features ESP32-S3 WiSoC, LR1121 LoRa transceiver, 3.5-inch touchscreen display

content:
Makerfabs Nomad Terminal handheld development platform is built around an ESP32-S3 MCU and a Semtech LR1121 LoRa transceiver for long-range wireless communication, as well as an ATGM336H GNSS module for positioning. The device can be used for applications such as LoRa messaging, GPS tracking, navigation, and remote sensor monitoring without a cellular connection. It also includes a 9-axis motion sensor, a microSD card slot, an RTC, and a 5,000 mAh rechargeable battery. Makerfabs Nomad Terminal specifications: Wireless Module – ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-S3 CPU – Dual-core Tensilica LX7 up to 240 MHz with vector extension for AI/ML workloads RAM – 512KB SRAM; 8MB PSRAM Wireless – WiFi 4 and Bluetooth LE 5 Storage – 16MB flash Antenna – PCB antenna Storage – MicroSD card slot for local data logging Display – 3.5-inch 480×320 TFT LCD (ILI9488 controller via SPI) with FT6236 capacitive touch panel Wireless WiFi 4 and Bluetooth [...]
